annotations.title: Check whether a website is down

description: Use this when the user asks whether a specific website, URL or API endpoint is down, unreachable or slow: "is my site down or is it just me?", "is api.example.com reachable from Europe?". Requests the URL once from six regions (Ashburn, San Jose, London, Frankfurt, Singapore and Sydney) and returns each region's result (up, down, blocked or inconclusive), status code and timings, with an overall verdict. A host is checked at most once every 5 minutes; a repeat returns that result and its age. Never returns page content. Not for named third-party services like Stripe or AWS: use check_service_status, which also reads the vendor's own status page. Not for a site the user monitors with FlareWarden: diagnose_site checks it from every region FlareWarden checks from, as its own monitoring.

url.description: The website or endpoint to check, such as https://example.com or api.example.com/health. Query strings are ignored.

name: check_service_status_url
title: Check whether a website is down
